description: This file defines the Option class in the Opencart admin module. It provides methods for managing product options in an e-commerce system, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving options and their descriptions, values, and related data. It interacts extensively with the database to perform CRUD operations for options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Class for managing product options in the admin panel, including CRUD operations for options, descriptions, and values. Extends the base Model class in the Opencart system engine.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Creates a new product option in the database, inserting its core data and descriptions, and optionally its values. Returns the primary key of the inserted option.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing product option and its descriptions and values based on the provided option ID.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes a product option and its associated descriptions and values from the database.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a single option record along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple option records based on filters, supporting sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of options in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific option in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all option descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for an option, keyed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all option descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new value (option choice) for an option, including its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values related to a specific option.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value record, including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for an option, with descriptions for the current language, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific option value in a given language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for an option.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for a particular language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all value descriptions for an option, structured by value.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all value descriptions for a specific language.
